# .infracode

This directory is generated by the infracode repository. Files that carry the `Code generated by infracode` marker are outputs and must not be edited by hand.

## Layout

- `infracode/` — handwritten source manifests (inputs). Make changes here.
- `.infracode/generated/` — shadow output root (gitignored, never committed).
- `.infracode/index/` — verification index (committed).
- `.infracode/development/` — developer experience outputs (e.g. Tilt).
- `.infracode/environments/` — environment/production outputs.

## Workflow

1. Edit the source manifests under `infracode/` (and the domain code that renders them).
2. Run `make generate` to render the artifacts.
3. Run `make generate-verify` to confirm committed output matches the source manifest.
4. Commit the generated artifacts so GitOps can materialize the reviewed output directly from Git.

Never edit files that carry the generated marker. Change the source manifests and regenerate instead.
